query: Which actors worked on which highly rated (>9.0) drama TV series released after 2025 and what alternative titles were used in France?
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT p.name, t.primary_title, r.rating , a.title AS french_title FROM titles t JOIN ratings r ON t.title_id = r.title_id JOIN crew c ON c.title_id = t.title_id JOIN people p ON p.person_id = c.person_id LEFT JOIN akas a ON t.title_id = a.title_id WHERE t.genres LIKE '%Drama%' AND t.premiered > 2025 AND r.rating > 9.0 AND t.type IN ('tvSeries', 'tvMiniSeries')
